title: Авито перед сезоном: шиномонтаж на кроссовер, и хранение, про которое пришлось спросить дважды
demonstrates: An Avito price question a day before the tyre window. Slot 17 sends the first draft as it was, answers the first half of a double question himself, and gets to the second half 58 minutes after it is asked again, editing the draft into a booking with the address. He labels it and does not resolve.
